note: P is one design four times: all Ember & Oak, Georgia serif on cream and espresso, a pill nav and a bento panel dropping down below it. Q has four brands (Tinwell, Tin & Ember, Kiln & Kettle, Kettle & Ember) with condensed type, a dark theme, a tin-stack handle, a floating popover and an always-visible folded tile strip, so the collapse itself differs. R is mostly Ember & Oak in warm browns, with the same inline drop-down panel and only small differences in nav shape, panel placement and tile content (R4 renames the brand). None of the twelve breaks the fixed points: each is a coffee-company bento menu that collapses and expands.
